# criblio_pack_global_vars (Data Source)

Returns all matching objects in `items`, following API pagination automatically. Scope the request using the required attributes below. An empty collection returns an empty list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "criblio_pack_global_vars" "example" {
  group_id = "default"
  pack     = "example"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Worker group ID.
- `pack` (String) The <code>id</code> of the Pack.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `args` (Attributes List) Argument definitions for expression-type variables. Each item has type and name (e.g. for (val / 1073741824).toFixed(precision || 5)). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--args))
- `description` (String) Brief description of the Global Variable.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the Global Variable.
- `lib` (String) Library that contains the Global Variable.
- `pack` (String) The <code>id</code> of the Pack.
- `tags` (String) Metadata tags for categorizing and filtering Global Variables.
- `type` (String) Data type of the Global Variable value.
- `value` (String) Value of the Global Variable. When the type is expression, enter a JavaScript expression.

<a id="nestedatt--items--args"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.args`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Argument type (e.g. number, string)
- `name` (String) Argument name
